reviews.comment: Dr. Strawser's class was difficult but he is pretty approachable and I appreciated his help and guidance on things. He can be a bit intimidating.
Hard not to get an A with his grading policy which is super lax. Funny guy, Bob is the best!

Bob is a great guy who really cares about his students, loved having him as a professor. Dry sense of humor and would definitely take him again. Lectures helped out a lot, and the exams are just like the practice problems. Bob is awesome

Bob Strawser is my fave prof at TAMU, hands down. He loves A&M, accounting, and his students so much. He comes to class with a smile on his face and puts a smile on my face every class. He passes out bonus points like candy, has the easiest online quizzes, tests are exactly like what he does in class, and gives even more extra credit at the end!

Mr. Strawser is possibly the most sympathetic professor at the university. Especially during this COVID nonsense, he has been very accessible through email. Any time a student has asked a question he has included it in a mass email he sends out every couple days so that the class can see what people are concerned about. He is a very caring person!!

Bob is an extremely nice professor and exhibits genuine care for his students! He is approachable and makes himself available to help when students need him. That said, this is a very difficult class. Exams are very similar to homework. Class time is used primarily for working problems, not truly lecturing. Great guy, tough class, overall not bad.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Accounting with Bob. He was a straight-forward professor. Lecture notes were always posted online, so if you miss class you can catch up after. He drops your lowest exam grade, and if you do well on your final, it replaces your average. Overall, it was a stress less, laid back class.
This professor types every single lecture note, and even the EXAMS in Comic Sans. You will absolutely be teaching yourself accounting 210.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Bob really cares about his students and offers "bonus" points literally for answering semi-difficult questions in class. His tests are almost identical to the class work (with a few curve balls), and he is extremely lax about grading and makeup tests. Go to class, pay attention, study the lecture notes. Very attainable A

I feel bad saying anything bad about Dr. Strawser because it's clear that he really cares about his students, however, he is a terrible professor. He is very smart, but not a good teacher. The class was extremely difficult for me because I essentially had to teach myself. If you have the option to take another professor, I would recommend that.

Stawser is a sweet man who cares for his students. However, his 230H course felt random. His 3 exams were problems from class w/ different numbers, but the final had lots of material that we hadn't ever touched. Luckily, he gives plenty of opportunties for EC and always works with students. If you need a class with structure, consider other options

Great professor who legitimately wants you to do well, essentially tells you what's on the exams. Make sure to read the textbook for the exams, and make sure to work the problems over and over. His grading system is goofy, but if you get an A on the final, you get an A in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is probably one of the most helpful professors I have had. He takes special care (almost an annoying amount of care) to answer any questions before moving on from material. He is very willing to help individuals 1 on 1 with any struggles they have. The tests are almost exactly like the example problems in his lectures just with different numbers

Strawser is an extremely smart man. Head of the finance dept for A&M and teaches for fun. You have a WAY better chance at making a good grade in his class than you do in another because he doesn't really give below C's and 90% make an A or B. With that being said, this is a hard class, and his teaching style is totally different from everyone else.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He literally gives lectures over problems which he just changes numbers for the tests. If you go to class this is an easy A. However the material is not easy. If you talk to him after class or in his office that will also help. Great guy and great Prof.

The guy doesnt know how to teach. However, hes very good at mumbling to himself as he writes on the overhead like he's in a race without regulations on legibility. SI leader was hot though, so it wasnt all bad...
